earth.headline: It began as fire.
earth.body: Deep underground, heat and unimaginable pressure forge raw minerals into stone — slowly, and never the same way twice.
earth.alt: Molten rock glowing orange from within the dark earth

unearthed.headline: Then it met the light.
unearthed.body: A single block breaks free of the quarry wall — tonnes of raw earth, lifted whole into the sun.
unearthed.alt: Towering white marble quarry wall with an excavator for scale

cut.headline: One cut. A pattern no one has ever seen.
cut.body: The saw opens the block and the veins appear — a design nature draws just once, and never repeats.
cut.alt: Close-up of a sawn marble slab revealing its natural veining

craft.headline: Then human hands take over.
craft.body: Cut, calibrated and polished by hand until raw rock becomes a deep, mirror-still shine.
craft.alt: A stonemason's dust-covered hand guiding a chisel to carve a stone column

home.headline: And finally, it comes home.
home.body: A kitchen. A hearth. A landmark. A piece of the earth, made to outlast us all.
home.alt: A luxurious marble kitchen with a grand veined island at rest

About.title: A quarry-to-container powerhouse
About.lead: Granitopia Stones International LLP is an exporter of exquisite natural stone, delivering granite, marble, quartzite and more to over 38 countries.
About.p1: From strategically located quarries across India, we select blocks for colour, grain and structural integrity — the foundation of every great slab.
About.p2: Across four manufacturing units, blocks are gang-sawn, calibrated and finished by master craftsmen and precision machines to exacting tolerances.
About.p3: Every year we process 200,000 square metres and ship 35 containers — reliably, and on time.
About.missionBody: To bring the finest natural stone from Indian quarries to the world's most demanding projects, with uncompromising quality and service.
About.visionBody: To be the most trusted name in natural stone export — a true utopia of stone.
About.subtitle: From quarries across India to landmark projects in 38+ countries — natural stone, delivered whole.

sections.heading: Responsible for content (§ 18 (2) MStV)

sections.heading: Liability for content
sections.body: We prepare the content of this site with care, but assume no liability for its accuracy, completeness or timeliness. As a service provider we are responsible for our own content under general law; we are not obliged to monitor transmitted or stored third-party information.

sections.heading: Liability for links
sections.body: This site may contain links to external websites over which we have no control. We accept no liability for their content; the respective operator is responsible.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we handle your personal data when you use this website, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP).

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body:
Granitopia Stones International LLP, Bengaluru, India.
Contact: sales@granitopia.com.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: When you submit the enquiry form: your name, email and country, and optionally your phone, the stone of interest and your message. If you consent, we collect anonymous, privacy-friendly traffic statistics (Vercel Analytics). We do not use advertising cookies or profiling.

sections.heading: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: We use enquiry data to respond and prepare a possible quotation — Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual steps) and Art. 6(1)(a) (your consent for the message you send). Analytics are used only with your consent — Art. 6(1)(a).

sections.heading: Recipients
sections.body: Hosting is provided by Vercel Inc. Enquiry submissions are handled by our email / form provider. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: International transfers
sections.body: As an India-based company, your data may be processed outside the European Economic Area. Where required, appropriate safeguards (such as Standard Contractual Clauses) are applied. Details on request.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: We keep enquiry data only for as long as needed to handle your request and to meet legal obligations, then delete it.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability, and object to processing. You may withdraw consent at any time and lodge a complaint with a data-protection supervisory authority.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy request, email sales@granitopia.com.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.intro: What we store on your device, and how to control it.

sections.heading: What we use
sections.body: We store a small local setting that remembers your cookie choice. If you accept, we enable privacy-friendly, anonymous traffic analytics (Vercel Analytics). We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Managing your choice
sections.body: You can decline via the banner, or clear your browser's site data to reset your choice at any time.
